title: tunnelmind:code_crew:v1 — Attestation Block period_summary
description: Validates the `period_summary` object of an ATAP v0.1 Attestation Block under the tunnelmind:code_crew:v1 profile. Every field is a non-negative integer count over the block's events. No field resolves to a natural person (ATAP v0.1 §7.6).

tokens.description: Model tokens spent by the crew in the period.

overturns.description: Per agent role: how many of that role's verdicts a later step overturned (e.g. a QA accept the reviewer failed).
